summary_en: ¥40.0B upper limit; 14M shares (8.6% of S/O ex-treasury); open-market acquisition; execution window 1 Nov 2026 – 31 Oct 2027.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 30 July 2026, the board of Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan Holdings resolved to initiate a treasury-share acquisition programme. The company will acquire up to 14 million ordinary shares (representing 8.6% of shares outstanding excluding treasury as of 29 July 2026) for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥40.0 billion. Execution will occur via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 1 November 2026 and 31 October 2027. The company states the acquisition supports profit distribution to shareholders and improvement in capital efficiency as part of its medium-term management plan Vision 2030.
